vocabulary.definition: introducing or developing something new and innovative

vocabulary.definition: not aware of or not noticing something; existing in the mind but not immediately available to consciousness
vocabulary.example: His actions were driven by unconscious impulses.

vocabulary.definition: subdued, restrained, or inhibited; kept under control through force
vocabulary.example: She had repressed memories of her traumatic childhood.

vocabulary.definition: a person who is obsessively egotistical or self-centered
vocabulary.example: He was labeled as an egomaniac due to his constant need for attention.

vocabulary.definition: incorrect or inappropriate use or application

vocabulary.definition: existing only in the imagination; unreal; whimsical
